items.title: Fashion Icons
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Hold on tight! Become the fashion icon everyone dreams of and live everyday life as a superstar. Dress in the never seen before, the latest and the most luxurious garments ever made and set new trends in the world. Reach the status of a celebrity!

+1 free skin
+12 fashionable skins
+Perfect for role-playing

items.title: Winter Race
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Calling all racers and speed enthusiasts! Do you like the winter season as we do? If so, then stay warm and dress tight. The race is beginning soon!

- 2 racetracks and an entertainment area!
- A variety of vehicles (snowmobiles, sleds, and more!)
- Includes a color-customization tool! 
- By Block Tale Studios

items.title: Creepy Clowns
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Trick or treat? Halloween has arrived and with it the creepy clowns. Dress up as your favorite creepy clown and scare and entertain your way through your friend group this Halloween night.

+ 12 creepy costumes
+ Perfect for clowning about
+ Made for roleplay

items.title: Teen Champions
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
We are the champions! We're the best at what we do! We grind every day at our craft to prove to the world that we're the champions!

+ 12 roleplay skins!
+ Competitive attire inspired by olympic champions!

items.title: Teen Hoodies
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
The weather is getting cooler and so are you. Throw on your favorite hoodie and dress to impress. Match your teen lifestyle with an even cooler hoodie.

+ Perfect for teens
+ Get warm with 12 hoodies

items.title: Cute Cartoon Mobs
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
If you're all about adding some cuteness to your world, look no further! With this skin pack of reimagined mobs, cuteness is the main ingredient. From creepers to zombies, you'll never see monsters the same way again!

- Includes 8 adorable skins
- Each mob skin revamped in HD and stunning color
- By SmartPixel & Pathway Studios

items.title: 8-Bit Horror
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Bring back some vintage looks with this skin pack of 8-bit creatures perfect for adding a splash of horror to any world. You'll see familiar foes like skeletons, ghosts, and spiders, but some new faces like aliens and tentacled monstrosities!

- Includes 10 horrifyingly retro skins!
- Each monster is unique with varying colors and details
- By Thezi & Pathway Studios

items.title: First Responders
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
When in danger, call the first responders. Police officers will protect you from bandits, firefighters will protect you from fires, the emergency squad is also included in this sensational pack of real-life heroes. Make the difference, be part of this amazing team.

8 skins with real-life evil fighters
Perfect for role-playing with friends
By Varuna and Pathway Studios

items.title: The Radiant Blade
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
The Radiant Blade isn't just an old folk tale; it's truth, and now it's time to track down all the pieces, assemble it, and rule the kingdom you were destined to. No quest has prepared you for this!

- A survival adventure with an epic quest!
- Dynamic lighting: Just carry a torch to light up the mysterious caves around you.
- By EnderQuest Studios & Pathway Studio

items.title: Neon City Parkour
items.creator: Sandbox Network
items.description:
You're stuck in a space full of mysterious neon! Escape all nine levels in the city of neon, defeat the boss!
- Only singleplayer
- 4 difficulties
- 9 rounds
- 8 achievements in game
- 4 skins

items.title: I STILL HAVE FEELINGS
items.creator: Lebleb
items.description:
Do you STILL not know how to express yourself? Would you like some help? This skin pack for you and anyone else who still has feelings.

This skin pack includes 12 skins with different expressions.

items.title: Candy Hunters
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
This halloween you become the hunter... for candy! 

*12 candy hunters
*2 skins free

items.title: Zombie Teens
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Not even a bedtime could keep these teens from playing beyond the graves.

*16 zombie teens
*2 skins free

items.title: Ghost Hunters
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
There's something strange here.

*14 ghosts & hunters
*2 skins free

items.title: Chicken Club
items.creator: Yeggs
items.description:
Welcome to the club. Transform into 8 incredible chickens to WOW your hen friends, rooster buddies, and the rest of the coop. Cock-a-doodle-doo!

+ Includes 8 clucktastic skins!

items.title: ZOMBIES!
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
Halloween is here and the ZOMBIES are back! Time to get spooky with these awesome zombies!

+ Great for survival or roleplay
+ Scary skins

items.title: Island Escape
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description: Challenge your skills and escape the island. Battle zombified Scientists and wild boar as you test your cognitive thinking in this problem-solving island.

items.title: Honey Teens
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
Sweeten up with these amazing skins made of honey!

- 12 Skins
- 1 Free skin
- By UnderBlocks

items.title: Rapper Teens
items.creator: Novasoft
items.description:
Take the stage and roleplay as a world-famous rapper! Play in your home city, or overseas to thousands of teens and fans. 

- 10 Rapper skins to choose from!
- Perfect for roleplay, or to show off on servers.

By Aurrora Skins

items.title: Flower Teens
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
Enjoy these amazing skins with a touch of a beautiful flower

-12 skins
-1 Free skin
-By UnderBlocks

items.title: One Block Lucky Block
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
One Block and lucky block come together and now you must try to survive!
Mine for necessary resources where lucky blocks randomly appear! 
Try your luck, have fun and survive!


+ Original and advanced modes!
+ Random chance for lucky blocks!
+ Try advanced mode where new islands spawn!
+ Exciting and crazy survival experience!

items.title: Acid Dragon Knights
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Join these powerful acid knights full of pure evil in your next big journey! Set out with you and your friends and rule all the kingdoms and dragons with these acid warrior knight skins! With glowing neon green eyes and epic armor no one should be able to phase you!

- 12 dragon warrior knight skins!
- By Hourglass Studios

items.title: Mob Costumes
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
It's the season for spooky masks and scaring your friends! Dress up as your favorite mob with these brand new mob costumes!

- 8 skins!
- A wide variety of outfits for you to pick from! 

Which one suits you best?

items.title: Cyber Mobs
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Light up the streets with these brand new cyber outfits, complete with high tech equipment and futuristic masks!

- 8 skins!
- Different mob designs and outfits so you can pick the skin that suits you best!
